entries.description: A Canadian producer known for his dance and techno music widely posted on social media. Character based off art from 2015 album 'The Dancing Dead'. Play track 4 'Monster Dance Off' in RoBeats!

From the artist: When I showed this character to the vocalist Aya Majiro, she said "I want to use this avatar too.". We named the character "Ushi-chan" (Ushi is cow in Japanese, and her horns resemble those of a cow).
entries.name: Ushi-chan

entries.description: Mastering many genres, mixing different styles and ready to bring you an unforgettable experience. A long-time RoBeats collaborator, the one and only Livid Lycanthrope, Hong Kong-based producer Ardolf is here!

entries.description: Sweet, huh? Art based off iroart's cover art for Tobu's 2020 track 'Louder Now'. Play it now in RoBeats!

Specializing in a bass-heavy yet emotionally evocative style, seatrus has produced a wide range of club and doujin tracks featured in a variety of games. Try their tracks 'Karakuri' and 'Viral Cleric' featured in RoBeats!

entries.description: You'll usually find Teresa at the teams building making sure everyone is getting their team contribution points. But this Halloween, she had something special planned...

entries.description: Chiptunes, also known as 8-bit music, is a retro genre with sounds reminiscent of those in vintage arcade, PC and console games of decades gone by. 8-bit Alien is here in all his pixellated glory to beep, boop and bop to these tracks in RoBeats!

entries.description: A Korean producer making energetic and high-tempo tracks featuring vocals in both Korean and Japanese. Featured in a variety of rhythm games - now including RoBeats!

entries.description: ughm...

entries.description: Favorite things: Music, Games, Ice Cocoa, Natto, Miso Soup. Features: Quite forgetful, getting up early, laid back. On the internet, often seen as a mage (Kuro), dog (Taro) and robot (Boro) trio. You may have heard their song 'Dark Sheep', which you can play in RoBeats!
entries.name: Chroma

entries.description: If you were stuck on a deserted tropical island, which mini would you want to bring? No need to answer that theoretical question - Summertime Zara is here! On an extended summer vacation from her usual gig at the Gear Shop, join her at our 'Castaways Concerts' stage!
entries.name: Summertime Zara

entries.description: Synthion (Synthia Iona) is an Korean American music producer, DJ, vocalist, instrumentalist, and VTuber. Classically trained since childhood, her energetic yet emotional 'love-core' style represents the cross-section of dance music and anime soundtracks. Play her tracks 'Sky Blue' and 'VIVIDVELOCITY' in RoBeats!
entries.name: Synthion

entries.description: A Japanese Future House/Jersey Bass producer with an unique style characterized by fast 'bouncy' grooves and kawaii-influenced samples. Featured in a variety of games, now including RoBeats! Play their songs 'Delusion' and 'Magenta Potion' in-game.
entries.name: EmoCosine

entries.description: Bleep and Bass! Erik Bjarngard, known professionally as Bossfight, is a Swedish EDM/Dubstep producer. Courtesy of Monstercat, you can now jam to several of his songs in RoBeats. Try his songs 'Endgame' and 'Overdose' in-game!
entries.name: Bossfight

entries.description: Someone must have updated DJ Hiku - because somehow we've activated Party Mode! Rave on with our playlist of all songs electronic and dance... ^_^

entries.description: With the falling of leaves and a brisk chill in the air, Autumn has arrived! Preferrably with hot drink in hand, celebrate the new season with our fall playlist, Autumn Festival Lisa and our all-new "Autumn Abode" stage. Don't forget a jacket!

entries.description: Voca-Hiku's here with a playlist of Vocaloid songs to enjoy! Vocaloid is a 'voice synthesizer' popular in Japan (and often paired with iconic anime mascots). Keisei is a producer known for his Vocaloid songs featured on Japanese video site 'niconico'. Play his song 'Bright City' in RoBeats!
entries.name: Voca-Hiku

entries.description: Pop a cork and make a toast! Let's count down the days, hours, minutes and seconds to the big moment. Zara's all dressed-up and here to wish you a very 'Happy New Year'!

entries.description: Juggernaut - a seemingly unstoppable force crushing whatever (or whoever) is in its path. A Japanese producer known for their prolific work in games and other collaborations. Character based off art from their album 'Distorted Heavens'.
entries.name: Juggernaut

entries.description: Hype & Love - Meet Halv! A prolific Japanese Arcade Core composer who's worked with many of your favorite artists, and been featured in many of your favorite rhythm games (now including RoBeats!). Try their songs 'Hype & Love', and 'Yabai-Jan' in RoBeats!

entries.description: Nice to meet (you)! Tokyo-based DJ/Producer, head of J-NERATION, and creator of club music with a focus on pop sounds. Featured in a variety of games - now including RoBeats!

entries.description: Kagetora - Nice to meet you! A self-taught composer influenced by 'Psychedelic Trance' and melodic Japanese-style music. Creator of label 'Greatoaks Music'. Featured with works in a variety of games (now including RoBeats!). Try their songs 'Critication' and 'Time to Beat the Odds'!
